ORANGE CITY MEDICAL CENTRE - Department of Medicine
DISCHARGE CERTIFICATE

This is to certify that Vikram Singh, 38 years, male, was admitted to this hospital on 2026-10-01 and discharged on 2026-10-03.
Diagnosis: Chikungunya fever.
Treatment given: Symptomatic treatment, IV fluids for 1 day.
He is advised rest for 10 days and review in the outpatient department.

Signed: Dr. Rakesh Kapoor
Registration No. OCMC-1180
